answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than banked indefinitely. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, fresh sybil identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted, reciprocal endorsements, they cannot cross the consensus threshold. Cipher-verified interactions anchor those endorsements, while a karst-like maze of fabricated links cannot make trust wander far from established peers.
